item.title: Minutes of the Market Participants Group meeting – 24 September 2026
item.description: The Market Participants Group (MPG) is a senior-level forum for financial market participants to share their views on relevant themes and narratives in financial markets with members of the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee.

item.title: Bank of England announces new office space in Leeds
item.description: The Bank of England has secured a new long-term premises in Leeds, marking a major milestone in its commitment to build its presence in the region.
